name: std::isxdigit(std::locale)

declarations.code:
template <class CharT>

bool isxdigit(CharT ch, const locale &loc);

intro: Checks if the given character is classified as a hexadecimal digit by the given locale's std::ctype facet.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Returns true if the character is classified as a hexadecimal digit, false otherwise.

sections.title: Possible implementation
